about:
Nexus Electronics LLC operates from Corona, California, as an authorized distributor of automotive and electronic components. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides authorized electronic component distribution with extensive in-stock inventory and worldwide sourcing for production, obsolete, allocated, and hard-to-find requirements. Its services include BOM upload and quoting, parametric component search, cross-referencing, and engineering assistance. Nexus carries authorized lines from manufacturers such as Yazaki, Bosch, Sumitomo, Eaton, MTA, VTE, and Snap Action, supplying products including sealed connectors, on-board battery chargers, and automotive circuit breakers.

Nexus serves the automotive components and automotive tested industries, with a focus on commercial EV manufacturers, vehicle power applications, and industrial applications. Customers include OEMs and production buyers seeking genuine components with manufacturer-backed supply and technical support.

The company emphasizes its quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and a BBB A+ rating, positioning itself as a distribution partner built around support, offering direct manufacturer access, manufacturer-backed supply, and worldwide sourcing capabilities.
